description: Flutter mobile: add ProductImage/ProductOffer/ProductRatings Freezed models and extend ProductData in ranked_product.dart, create ProductDetailRepository, wire it into repositories_providers.dart, regenerate all Freezed/Riverpod code, and completely rebuild product_details_screen.dart with an image gallery carousel, all-offers scroll, full description/features/specs/materials sections, and shimmer loading.
steps: Step 1 — Update mobile/lib/shared/models/ranked_product.dart: Add three new @freezed models BEFORE the existing ProductData class. (a) ProductImage: const factory ProductImage({required String url, @JsonKey(name:'cleaned_url') String? cleanedUrl, @JsonKey(name:'is_main_image') @Default(false) bool isMainImage, @JsonKey(name:'shot_type') String? shotType, @JsonKey(name:'alt_text') String? altText}) = _ProductImage; factory ProductImage.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic> json) => _$ProductImageFromJson(json). (b) ProductOffer: const factory ProductOffer({required String url, required String domain, required double price, @JsonKey(name:'compare_at_price') double? compareAtPrice, required String currency, required String availability, String? condition}) = _ProductOffer; factory ProductOffer.fromJson(...) (c) ProductRatings: const factory ProductRatings({required double value, required int count, @JsonKey(name:'source_count') required int sourceCount}) = _ProductRatings; factory ProductRatings.fromJson(...). Then in the existing ProductData factory, add these new fields after the existing 'retrievedAt' field: @JsonKey(name:'all_images') @Default([]) List<ProductImage> allImages, @JsonKey(name:'all_offers') @Default([]) List<ProductOffer> allOffers, ProductRatings? ratings, List<String>? materials, @JsonKey(name:'key_features') List<String>? keyFeatures, @JsonKey(name:'structured_attributes') Map<String,dynamic>? structuredAttributes, @JsonKey(name:'category_title') String? categoryTitle, String? description. Keep all existing ProductData fields and the entire RankedProduct class unchanged.

Step 2 — Create mobile/lib/core/networking/product_detail_repository.dart following the exact pattern of products_repository.dart: class ProductDetailRepository { ProductDetailRepository(this._dio); final Dio _dio; Future<ProductData?> getProductDetail(String channel3ProductId) async { try { final response = await _dio.get<Map<String,dynamic>>('/api/v1/products/detail/$channel3ProductId'); if (response.data == null) return null; return ProductData.fromJson(response.data!); } on DioException catch (e) { if (e.response?.statusCode == 404) return null; if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('[ProductDetailRepository] error: $e'); return null; } catch (e) { if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('[ProductDetailRepository] error: $e'); return null; } } }. Import dio, flutter/foundation.dart, and ../../shared/models/ranked_product.dart.

Step 3 — Update mobile/lib/core/networking/repositories_providers.dart: Add import for product_detail_repository.dart. Add a new @riverpod function: ProductDetailRepository productDetailRepository(Ref ref) => ProductDetailRepository(ref.watch(apiClientProvider));. This triggers riverpod_generator to emit productDetailRepositoryProvider in the .g.dart file.

Step 4 — Run build_runner to regenerate all generated files: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/mobile && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs. This regenerates: ranked_product.freezed.dart, ranked_product.g.dart (for the 3 new models + extended ProductData), repositories_providers.g.dart (for the new productDetailRepository provider). Fix any codegen errors before proceeding.

Step 5 — Completely rewrite mobile/lib/features/product_details/product_details_screen.dart. The new file must: (A) Add imports: package:flutter_riverpod, package:go_router, package:cached_network_image, package:intl, package:url_launcher, app/theme.dart, features/product_comparison/constraint_badge.dart, shared/models/ranked_product.dart, features/product_details/selected_product_provider.dart, core/networking/repositories_providers.dart, core/widgets/shimmer_widgets.dart. (B) Keep the outer ProductDetailsScreen ConsumerWidget identical to today — same constructor, same GoRouter extra / selectedProductProvider fallback, same null guard. Change _ProductDetailsView to a ConsumerStatefulWidget. (C) In _ProductDetailsViewState: declare PageController _pageController and int _currentPage=0; in initState, if product.productData.channel3ProductId != null, trigger an async load via ref.read(productDetailRepositoryProvider).getProductDetail(id) storing result in a local AsyncValue<ProductData?> state field (use a Future stored in state and rendered with FutureBuilder, OR use a separate StateProvider — use a simple Future<ProductData?> field _detailFuture and FutureBuilder). Show ProductDetailsShimmer() while loading. On error or null result, fall back gracefully to showing the existing productData without crash. (D) Build layout inside a Scaffold with no AppBar (use floating back button instead). Body is SafeArea > SingleChildScrollView. Layout sections in order:

  SECTION 1 — IMAGE GALLERY: Stack containing: (i) SizedBox(height:300) with PageView.builder over effectiveData.allImages (use cleanedUrl ?? url for CachedNetworkImage); each page uses CachedNetworkImage(placeholder: (ctx,url)=>ProofShimmer(child:ShimmerBox(width:double.infinity,height:300,radius:0)), errorWidget: _ImagePlaceholder(), fit:BoxFit.cover). If allImages is empty, show single _ImagePlaceholder. (ii) Positioned top-left: back button — GestureDetector wrapping Container(margin:EdgeInsets.only(top:48,left:16), decoration:BoxDecoration(color:Colors.white,borderRadius:BorderRadius.circular(20),boxShadow:[...]), child:Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size:18, color:Color(0xFF0F172A))) that calls context.pop(). (iii) If allImages.length > 1: Positioned bottom:12, centered Row of dot indicators — current dot: Container(width:8,height:8,decoration:BoxDecoration(color:ProofBuyColors.accent,shape:BoxShape.circle)); other dots: Container(width:6,height:6,color:Color(0xFFCBD5E1),shape:circle).

  SECTION 2 — PADDED CONTENT (horizontal padding 20): brand name if merchant non-null (pjs(12,grey 0xFF64748B)), product title 24px w800, ratings row (if ratings != null: Row with Icon(Icons.star_rounded,color:Color(0xFFF59E0B),size:16), Text('${ratings.value.toStringAsFixed(1)}',pjs(13,w700)), Text('(${ratings.count} reviews)',pjs(12,grey))), category pill (if categoryTitle != null: Chip with label pjs(11), backgroundColor 0xFFEFF6FF, side none), Divider.

  SECTION 3 — PRICE: best price = effectiveData.price formatted with NumberFormat.currency(symbol:'\$'). Show large 24px w800 blue. If allOffers is non-empty, find lowest price: `final bestOffer = allOffers.reduce((a,b)=>a.price<b.price?a:b)`. Show compare_at strikethrough if bestOffer.compareAtPrice != null and > price. Show availability badge: green 'In Stock' or red 'Out of Stock' based on first offer's availability.

  SECTION 4 — ALL OFFERS horizontal scroll: if allOffers non-empty, show section title 'Available From' 14px w700, then SizedBox(height:110) with ListView.builder(scrollDirection:Axis.horizontal) of offer cards (width:160, white rounded-16 card): domain name bold 13px, price 16px w700 blue, availability 11px colored text, 'Shop Now' ElevatedButton height:32 that calls launchUrl(Uri.parse(offer.url), mode:LaunchMode.externalApplication). Divider.

  SECTION 5 — DESCRIPTION: source = effectiveData.description ?? specs?['description']. If non-null and non-empty: section heading 'Description' 14px w700, full text pjs(13, height:1.55, color:0xFF475569). NO truncation.

  SECTION 6 — KEY FEATURES: source = effectiveData.keyFeatures (non-empty) ?? (specs?['features'] as List?). If non-empty: section heading 'Key Features' 14px w700, each feature as Row(Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded,size:15,color:0xFF10B981), SizedBox(8), Expanded(Text(f))). NO truncation.

  SECTION 7 — SPECIFICATIONS: techSpecs = specs entries where key not in ['description','features']. If non-empty: ExpansionTile 'Technical Specifications' — keep existing Wrap/grid layout from current screen.

  SECTION 8 — MATERIALS: if effectiveData.materials non-empty: section heading 'Materials' 14px w700, Wrap of Chip widgets (label: pjs(12), backgroundColor:0xFFF1F5F9, side: BorderSide(color:0xFFE2E8F0)).

  SECTION 9 — AI EXPLANATION card: keep exact existing implementation (blue card, auto_awesome icon).

  SECTION 10 — CONSTRAINT RESULTS: keep exact existing implementation.

  SECTION 11 — AI MATCH CONFIDENCE bar: keep exact existing implementation.

  SECTION 12 — BUY WITH PAYPAL full-width button: keep exact existing implementation (navigates to /review/productResultId).

  SECTION 13 — VIEW ON RETAILER: keep exact existing OutlinedButton.icon implementation.

  CRITICAL RULES: Use pjs() for ALL text. Use ProofBuyColors constants. Use cleanedUrl ?? url for all image sources. Never call maxLines/overflow on description or features text.

Step 6 — Run flutter analyze and fix all errors: cd /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/mobile && flutter analyze. Common issues to watch for: (a) FutureBuilder type parameter mismatch — be explicit: FutureBuilder<ProductData?>(future:_detailFuture,...). (b) _ImagePlaceholder referenced as class — keep the class at bottom of file. (c) Missing import for url_launcher LaunchMode. (d) Unused imports from old screen. (e) If build_runner generated a hash conflict in repositories_providers.g.dart, re-run build_runner.

repositories_providers.dart has productDetailRepository function and productDetailRepositoryProvider is in the generated .g.dart
product_details_screen.dart shows a PageView image gallery with dot indicators, all-offers horizontal scroll, full description, key features bullet list, materials chips, and shimmer loading state
flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs exits with zero errors
flutter analyze exits with zero errors

ProductData extended with allImages, allOffers, ratings, materials, keyFeatures, structuredAttributes, categoryTitle, description fields (all with @Default([]) or nullable). product_detail_repository.dart created following products_repository.dart pattern — calls GET /api/v1/products/detail/{channel3ProductId}, returns null on 404 or error. repositories_providers.dart updated with productDetailRepository @riverpod function. build_runner regenerated ranked_product.freezed.dart, ranked_product.g.dart, repositories_providers.g.dart with zero errors. product_details_screen.dart completely rewritten: _ProductDetailsView converted to ConsumerStatefulWidget with PageController + FutureBuilder pattern for async detail fetch; image gallery PageView with dot indicators; all-offers horizontal scroll with Shop Now buttons; full description/key-features/specs/materials sections; shimmer loading via ProductDetailsShimmer while future is pending; graceful fallback to original productData on null/error. flutter analyze: no issues found.
